name: claude-pip
description: Use when a message contains any of the all-caps triggers CLAUDE PIP, LOCAL PIP, OFF THE PIP, PRUNE THE PIP, or PROMOTE THE PIP (lowercase does not activate), or when the user asks to audit, prune, graduate, or remove PIP rules — e.g. "audit the PIP", "prune PIP before compact", "graduate a PIP rule". Covers capturing, scoping, removing, auditing, and promoting deterministic behavioral rules in CLAUDE-PIP.md / CLAUDE.md.
